sections.title: Haven's own player on phones
lines: iPhone, iPad and Android now play inside Haven, with the same player as the computers.
Audio and subtitle choices, speed, resume where you left off and the next episode, all in Haven.

sections.title: A new look
lines: Three posters across on phones, each with its rating.
Home's banner shows the title's logo with IMDb, TMDB and Rotten Tomatoes scores.

sections.title: Library › Local
lines: A new tab for the videos already on your device. Tap one to play it.

sections.title: Backups
lines: Your servers, accounts, lists and settings are backed up while Haven is open.
Restore it any time in Settings › Sync options.

sections.title: Haven Hub
lines: Run Haven on a Raspberry Pi or a small server and pair it in Settings › Media servers.

sections.title: Fixes
lines: Watchlist posters show again for titles brought in from Trakt or Simkl.
Smoother sideways scrolling: posters no longer light up as you swipe past them.
Android's Back button closes the player, not Haven.
On phones, a tap outside a text field closes the keyboard.
Home no longer leaves gaps where empty shelves were.
